sloka: व्यायच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा तत्परं रावणं रणे ।प्रहसन्निव काकुत्स्थः सन्दधे सायकान् शितान् ।। ६.१०९.२१ ।।
transliteration: vyāyacchamānaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā tatparaṁ rāvaṇaṁ raṇe ।prahasanniva kākutsthaḥ sandadhe sāyakān śitān ।। 6.109.21 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.
translations.hindi: हे सौभ्य ! यहाँ से तुम शीक्र जाओ और जाम्बवान्‌ मे जिस बर्चत का पता तुम्हें पहिले बतलाया था, उस 'ओषधिपर्वत पर जा कर
